description: 耐磨透气拼色短袖工装，前胸口袋与收紧下摆，上工好活动

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating warm paper off-white #F5F2EA fields and deep slate blue #33455A display fields, no scenic depth except the depot scene
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even studio light with a soft front key, controlled soft contact shadows, one warm accent rim in #EE6A23 for scene shots only
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte paper board #F5F2EA and matte deep-slate panel #33455A, garment laid flat or on an invisible form
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, bold headline plus small letter-spaced English eyebrow line
styleLock.iconSystem: solid geometric square and rectangular label chips in #EE6A23 or #24303F, no ornamental line icons
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero garment angle, consistent garment scale, collar and chest pocket kept clearly readable
noDrift: no color palette changes beyond #F5F2EA, #33455A, #EE6A23 and #24303F
no mixed fonts and no serif or script lettering
no visible brand marks, staff name tags or store badges
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent rugged team workwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm paper off-white #F5F2EA, deep slate blue #33455A, one safety-orange accent #EE6A23 and ink-navy text #24303F; bright even studio lighting with a soft front key and controlled soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; solid geometric label chips only; clean high-end apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero garment angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 黄蓝拼版主视觉，男模穿灰蓝拼色短袖拉链工装、抱空白纸箱竖拇指，标题为快递物流工作服套装与轻薄透气类文案；P2 灰布面料横幅加四枚空圆圈图标（柔软细腻/不变形/舒适透气/抗起球）与深蓝面料主张板；P3 产品信息屏：商品名称工作服、颜色灰/蓝、主布 95% 棉、厚度软硬弹力修身四组刻度、M-3XL 肩宽胸围衣长袖长尺码表；P4 产品解析屏：前胸口袋/下摆收紧/纽扣三条编号卖点配灰块图位与男模半身；P5-P7 细节展示：写字板手部特写、下摆纽扣、口袋纽扣与拼块缝线等局部；P8 底部含会员免费与二维码角标。品类判定依据：参数区品名明确写工作服，尺码表肩宽 46-50、胸围 55-62.5 为成人男装量级，画面为快递物流场景成人男模短袖拼色工装，故判 男装/工作服，与夹名一致。已剥离：男模面容与身份、原品牌字与英文字标、原文案原句、成分含量 95% 棉、尺码表实测数值、货号价格栏、会员免费角标与二维码、素材站贴片，产品一律以 {product} 占位，原文数值全部换为 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 或空白占位（空尺码格、空数值槽、空白 CTA 按钮位）。与近似模版差异（男装/上衣、下装、外套、套装各件均无工作服件，仍逐项另起体系）：1) 色板 #F5F2EA/#33455A/#EE6A23/#24303F 均未出现在库内任何男装套图；2) 背景体系为暖纸白与深板岩蓝双场交替加物流驿站暗场，无库内男装件使用过的酸柠、冰蓝、砖红、海军蓝横幅等体系；3) 道具体系为空白牛皮纸箱与空白尺码格/数值槽，区别于库内的衣架、人台、滑板、篮球、扶手椅、金属球等；4) 机位序列以低机位仰视收口与 90 度平铺信息板为特征，库内男装件无此组合；5) 角色序列 HERO>HERO>PAIN_POINT>SCENE>DETAIL>DETAIL>VARIANT>CTA 与相近件均不同。
